props.title: About Us
props.subtitle: Transforming agriculture through innovation and sustainable solutions since 2010.

leftContent.title: Corporate Profile
leftContent.description: We were established in 2010 with a visionary mission to transform Bangladesh's agricultural landscape. We recognized the challenges faced by local farmers and committed ourselves to developing innovative solutions that would enhance productivity while promoting sustainable farming practices.

cards.title: Our Vision
cards.description: To be the leading catalyst in transforming Bangladesh's agriculture into a sustainable, productive, and prosperous sector.

cards.title: Our Mission
cards.description: To provide innovative agricultural solutions, empower farmers with knowledge and technology, and promote sustainable practices.

cards.title: Our Values
cards.description: Innovation, Sustainability, Integrity, and Excellence in every solution we provide.

members.name: Dr. Mohammad Rahman
members.title: Managing Director & CEO
members.quote: We believe that the future of Bangladesh lies in the hands of our farmers.

items.title: Company Founded
items.description: The company was established with a vision to transform Bangladesh agriculture.

items.title: First Product Line Launch
items.description: Introduced our initial range of organic fertilizers to the market.

items.title: National Expansion
items.description: Expanded distribution network across all 64 districts of Bangladesh.

items.title: Sustainability Initiative
items.description: Launched comprehensive CSR programs including buy-back and afforestation.

items.title: Digital Transformation
items.description: Introduced digital platforms to better serve farmers and dealers.
